dp: DP is a person forced to flee from home or country.
DP means the same as displaced person or stateless person.
dph: DPH is a doctor's degree in preventive medicine.
DPH means the same as Doctor of Public Health.
dprk: DPRK is a communist country in the northern half of the Korean Peninsula.
DPRK means the same as North Korea or Democratic People's Republic of Korea or D.P.R.K..
dpt vaccine: DPT vaccine is abbreviation for combination vaccine against diphtheria and pertussis and tetanus toxoids.
